operator_decision: ratify P-SERVE-1 (kernel-champion serving A/B instrument) so the serving floor, serving gate and headline cite a section-2 protocol instead of being observations
amendment_class: new protocol (append to the owning annex; no new annex)

protocol_summary.scope: kernel/build/runtime-config effect on served decode throughput under the registered production recipe; fresh llama-server launch per sample; instrument_class=serving; unit = process; distinct from P-SERVE-SEL-1 (Annex Q)
protocol_summary.primary_metric: aggregate decode tok/s = sum over np slots of predicted_per_second (higher-better); effect = median(candidate)/median(anchor) - 1
protocol_summary.recipe: recipe_hash, launch argv, resolved-recipe build digests, paired ABBA order (matched_process_v2, 1-64 pairs), np/slots, frozen request digest
protocol_summary.residency: R23-60: sampled across the whole launch; proven needs the window to contain the request phase and >= 1 GiB VRAM; refuted raises ServingNotResident; unsampled is unproven (recorded, not refused)
protocol_summary.floor: unit process; matched floor n in 24-256 with a descriptive interval; legacy v1 floor n not enforced (listed in the enforcement state)
protocol_summary.headline: independent process launches, >= 14 per arm (28 total) at sd 2.793%, MDE 3.0%, alpha .05 two-sided, power .80
protocol_summary.gate: unit mismatch refuses; decisive = |effect| >= floor; PROMOTE only for a decisive, positive, non-regressing effect
